name: Protect the King 👑
desc:
Protect the King 👑

The World is in chaos! Shuma-Gorath has awoken and monstrous hordes surge across the lands. Defy the darkness and join forces with Conan the Barbarian in this brutal co-op wave survival game. Every blade counts!

🛡️ DEFEND the king and FIGHT against hordes of enemies!
⚔️ VENTURE through the World of Hyborean age!
🎖️ LEVEL UP your character and gear!
🤝 TEAM UP with friends and fight together in co-op!
🩷 LIKE & STAY TUNED for more updates!
